Keep-or-drop/merge decision needed. The temple is the famous white-marble complex at Dagapur, about 5 km from Siliguri on Darjeeling Main Road (near Savin Kingdom Resort), Dagapur, Siliguri 734003. It is dedicated to the saint Baba Lokenath (Lokenath Brahmachari, said to have lived 1730-1890 and attained enlightenment at age 90), whose following spans West Bengal, India and Bangladesh. The complex centres on a white lotus-shaped Padma Mandir of Baba Lokenath, with a striking split idol of Lord Shiva and Baba Lokenath forming two halves of one body; it also houses the Milan Mandir, a large Ganesha idol, Lakshmi-Narayan under Sheshnag at the entrance, an idol of Maa Ganga in a pond, and several other gods and goddesses.
